thread:
elaine: Quick pulse — found two post-launch gaps for the new open models (ozark-mini & cantaloupe-7b). Missing license_url in registry entries and perf jobs are failing for long-context tests. Need quick handoff: legal to verify licenses, infra to patch metadata repo, ML perf to triage quant variants. cc @sam @rahul @maya

sam: On it. I'll look into the metadata repo and open a PR if it's just a missing field. Which exact registry IDs?

elaine: Registry IDs: ozark-mini_v1 and cantaloupe-7b_v1. Example snippet (missing license_url / owners):
```json
{
  "model_id": "ozark-mini_v1",
  "display_name": "Ozark Mini",
  "license_url": ,
  "owners": [],
  "variants": ["q4_0","q8_0"]
}
```

maya: FYI perf summary I posted to the dashboard: long-context (>8k) jobs on cantaloupe-7b_q4 OOMs on g4dn.xlarge, ozark-mini_q8 has big tail latency. Short context perf is fine. Full logs: https://perf.redwood.dev/runs/2024-12-06-ozark

rahul: I can fast-track license review if the license_url is available. What's the expected license (Apache/CC-BY/etc)? If upstream has a standard SPDX tag we can reference it.

elaine: Upstream repo references "MIT" for ozark-mini and "CC-BY-4.0" for cantaloupe; need legal to confirm we can surface both. I'll paste the upstream links in the model-metadata PR.

sam: Opening quick PR to add license_url and owners, will add test to CI to fail on empty license.
ci-bot: Added status check: model-metadata/validate-license · failing

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-metadata/pull/482 — includes owners:@elaine and perf label. Requesting review from @maya and @rahul

maya: Reviewing now, if infra can provision a temporary larger instance I can re-run the long-context profile today to confirm whether quantization params or kernel selection is the culprit.

rahul: Reviewed PR comments — legal fine with MIT and CC-BY-4.0 for these models, just need upstream license URLs in canonical form. Elaine can you paste them?

elaine: Pasted URLs in PR description. Also added a note for ops: please enable a canary with cantaloupe-7b_q4 on g5.xlarge when ready. @sam can you coordinate?

sam: Will do. Timeline: I'll have PR green + deploy hook by EOD PST. If perf still fails we can roll back variant to q4_0->q8_0 map as a fallback.

maya: Sounds good. I'll re-run full suite once the metadata PR merges and tag results here.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Blocking items: (1) legal confirmation (rahul) — done. (2) metadata PR merge (sam). (3) infra canary provisioning (sam/ops). (4) perf re-run (maya). I'll follow up in this thread once PR merges. :thumbsup:
